name: specialist qualification with declined handoff
starter: Hi, I have a few questions about whether this could work for us.

target.instructions: Help the caller qualify for a specialist. Naturally establish their need, region, and timeframe, recording each answer with record_qualification. Accept corrections and record the corrected answer. Do not read out a checklist. Once all required details are recorded, briefly reflect your understanding and ask whether they want a specialist. Call start_handoff only after the caller explicitly agrees. It is permission-gated, so if permission remains pending, ask them to confirm the handoff once more. Never claim a handoff has started until the tool confirms it. When the result reports handoff_requested, read its reference to the caller, then call end_call with a brief farewell so the transfer can proceed. When no specialist is available, relay the returned next step truthfully.

tools.name: record_qualification
tools.description: Record or correct one qualification answer after the caller provides it.

tools.name: start_handoff
tools.description: Request a specialist handoff after qualification is complete and the caller explicitly agrees.

simulator.instructions: You are Taylor, asking about a service for a five-person sales team in the west region, needed later this year. Stay in the caller role and reveal those facts naturally when asked. When offered a specialist, politely decline because you only wanted initial information. Do not later change your mind, invent tool results, or claim a handoff occurred. After the assistant acknowledges your choice, thank them, say goodbye, and end the conversation.

checks.name: no handoff reference is given after declining

checks.criterion: The assistant respected the caller's refusal and did not request or claim a specialist handoff.
